context:
Goal: your coordinator questions get checked against past rulings instead of reaching you unchecked.
Problem (rule): PR #2306 raises the Stop hook's time limit in settings.json from 35 to 50 seconds, so a 30-second past-ruling run fits inside it. A settings.json change needs your word.
Based on (measured): cloud runs of the check took 10.1, 11.9 and 11.8 seconds against today's 15-second limit (3 runs). The prompt is 235 KB with 320 rulings. On the Mac under load it is unmeasured.
Departs from: main, where the check's limit is 15 s and the Stop hook's limit is 35 s — the PR makes them 30 s and 50 s, and logs one guard.log line per run.
Meanwhile: PR #2306 waits on this answer. Its other parts do not change.

options.gain: The check fits even when the Mac is busy, and the log gives the Mac numbers to tune it later.
options.label: Approve 50 seconds
options.lose: A slow Stop can hold the end of a turn up to 15 seconds longer.

options.label: Keep 35 seconds; merge only the 30-second check limit and the log
options.lose: When the Mac is busy, the Stop hook may cut the check off, so questions still reach you unchecked.

ref: PR #2306 (past-ruling timeout); step past-ruling-timeout; your ask of 15:14 CST
reply: Routed 17:24 CST Nov 8, closed 17:23 CST by the coordinator's word: the Stop hook limit goes to 50 s. Home: PR #2306, whose lane cites it; #2306 is with the batch runner.
short: Stop hook limit 35 s to 50 s?
title: Raise the Stop hook's time limit from 35 to 50 seconds, so the past-ruling check has time to finish?
